How it was computed (script at `/home/bench/work/repo/closure.py`):

- **Package map**: read each `packages/*/package.json` `name` → `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core`, `pi-ai`, `pi-coding-agent`, `pi-tui` (none match directory names, as noted).
- **Import extraction**: line-anchored regex matching `import|export … from "SPEC"` (semicolon-bounded so it can't run past a statement, but still spans multi-line clauses) plus bare `import "SPEC"`. I verified the extraction against a comment/string-stripped version of every `.ts` file in the repo — zero differences, so JSDoc examples like `import { CustomEditor } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent"` are correctly ignored, and bare imports like `packages/ai/src/stream.ts`'s `import "./providers/register-builtins.js"` are captured.
- **Resolution**: relative `.js`→`.ts`, directory→`index.ts`, exact package name→`src/index.ts`, subpath→first of `src/<sub>.ts`, `src/<sub>/index.ts`, `src/providers/<sub>.ts` (this handles `pi-ai/mcp`→`src/mcp.ts`, `/oauth`, `/bedrock-provider`). The only unresolved relative specifiers repo-wide were in `packages/ai/bedrock-provider.d.ts` and `packages/ai/scripts/generate-models.ts`, both irrelevant to this closure.
- **Traversal**: built the reverse edge map and BFS'd out from `packages/ai/src/types.ts` with a visited set, which is cycle-safe by construction.

Notable finding: **direct_importer_count is genuinely 0**. No file under `packages/coding-agent/src` names `ai/src/types.ts` in one hop — the only `pi-ai` specifiers used there are the bare package name (77×), `/mcp`, `/oauth`, and `/bedrock-provider`, and there are no relative paths into `packages/ai`. Everything reaches `types.ts` at ≥2 hops, typically via `packages/ai/src/index.ts`, which re-exports `./types.js` (e.g. `bun/register-bedrock.ts → ai/src/index.ts → ai/src/types.ts`). 187 of the 267 files reach it; spot-checking the 80 that don't (e.g. `src/config.ts`, which imports only node builtins and a local `utils/child-process.js`) confirms they're legitimately disconnected from the AI types. `.d.ts` files would have counted as `.ts`, but there are none under `packages/coding-agent/src`.
